> **Source evidence — current lab wiring**
>
> **Claim:** The lab values add access resources and the sidecar/mount separately; startup creates a directory, not a supported presentation publisher.
>
> **Implementation:** The values and startup lines below are the deployed-wiring inputs for this distinction.
>
> [The Nova values enable the private access resources](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/0e35889a3c4e65d5c47ba88e924611aace67eb1d/my-values/nova-values.yaml#L91-L96).
>
> [They separately define the actual sidecar and read-only workspace mount](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/0e35889a3c4e65d5c47ba88e924611aace67eb1d/my-values/nova-values.yaml#L151-L186).
>
> [Nova startup creates the directory but does not publish a document](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/0e35889a3c4e65d5c47ba88e924611aace67eb1d/charts/kubeclaw/templates/deployment.yaml#L454-L467).
>
> **Contract or setting:** The read-only prism/designs mount and separate extraContainers configuration must agree; the lab image tag is not an immutable release receipt.
>
> **Test evidence:** No maintained end-to-end producer test is identified because this inspected wiring supplies no publisher contract. The [native viewer test](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/569f7b4933d4859cc67c80ddf40d5154ffd95ce5/tests/verification/reliability/archviewer-native.test.mjs#L10-L26) creates its own presentation file; it is not a producer test or recorded run here.
>
> **Revision:** `0e35889a3c4e65d5c47ba88e924611aace67eb1d`. These are the source bindings for the explanation above, not execution receipts.
>
> **Limit:** A file served from the fixture or mounted tree does not establish authenticated production publication, revision selection, retention or cleanup.

The [Ops service method fixture](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/54a535b6046bc54e9aeeebee9c4cd24388477115/tools/ops-mcp/test/local.test.mjs#L43-L50) checks the separate MCP interface, not plugin activation.

> **Source evidence — dynamic HTTP families and Studio fallback**
>
> **Claim:** Dynamic outbound targets and Studio static fallback have different admission rules, not wildcard server authority.
>
> **Implementation:** HTTP provider policy, Kubernetes GET transport and Studio routing below define the selected families.
>
>
> [Buster validates the configured URL, origin, and port before it permits the dynamic target](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10/skills/buster/engine/test-gates/network-http-runtime.ts#L185-L198).
>
> [The request path enforces the method, headers, timeout, and byte ceilings before and during the dynamic fetch](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10/skills/buster/engine/test-gates/network-http-runtime.ts#L208-L268).
>
> [The common adapter converts its configured origins, methods, headers, timeout, and byte limits into an enforceable policy](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10/skills/common/plugins/network-http/src/adapter.ts#L18-L51).
>
> [Its fetch path applies cancellation, timeout, redirect, and response-size controls](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10/skills/common/plugins/network-http/src/adapter.ts#L53-L100).
>
> [Activation binds the dynamic canonical URL and method to that policy and checks the execution fence](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10/skills/common/plugins/network-http/src/adapter.ts#L107-L137).
>
> [Ops MCP fixes HTTPS and GET while accepting a validated dynamic Kubernetes API path, rotating token, CA, timeout, and response ceiling](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10/tools/ops-mcp/src/kubernetes.mjs#L1-L58).
>
> [Studio classifies health first, proxies only `/v1/`, and sends every other path to the bounded static-file/SPA responder](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10/skills/prism/server/studio-request.ts#L89-L139).
>
> **Contract or setting:** Origins, methods, headers, canonical URLs and static-root containment constrain their respective handlers.
>
> **Test evidence:** No complete deployed dynamic-target and static-fallback matrix execution is established here.
>
> **Revision:** `13bff0a18a64e74f2cbbaa1978e746fcdeff0c10`. Source bindings, not execution receipts.
>
> **Limit:** A symbolic endpoint is not a discovered concrete route or permission to call arbitrary addresses.
>

> **Source evidence — bounded Qdrant retirement**
>
> **Claim:** The script's fixed selector captures claim name/UID/volumeName. The script prechecks the reference and removes release/access resources. It then applies three reference tests plus `add Delete`, deletes PVCs by name, and waits for PVC/PV API deletion.
>
> **Implementation:** [Intent, context, tools, and temporary inventory](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/51975b92ed5154b76c65793e55933b4d8659d05d/scripts/remove-qdrant.sh#L6-L18). [Exact selection](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/51975b92ed5154b76c65793e55933b4d8659d05d/scripts/remove-qdrant.sh#L20-L30). [Precheck](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/51975b92ed5154b76c65793e55933b4d8659d05d/scripts/remove-qdrant.sh#L35-L43). [Release/resource removal](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/51975b92ed5154b76c65793e55933b4d8659d05d/scripts/remove-qdrant.sh#L46-L55). [Patch and waits](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/51975b92ed5154b76c65793e55933b4d8659d05d/scripts/remove-qdrant.sh#L57-L77).
>
> **Contract or setting:** [The seven selected existing-PV receiving contracts](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/0403b262df2dba24747a19d1f8f42ef3334ef779/scripts/docs-kubernetes-pv-selected-receiver-contracts.mjs#L13-L29) explain the ordered patch, guard limits, and controller/backend boundary. These source expectations use Kubernetes v1.35.0, not a live compatibility claim. [The API server rejects malformed or failed JSON patches](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/66452049f3d692768c39c797b21b793dce80314e/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/endpoints/handlers/patch.go#L403-L417). [Deletion reconciliation is separate](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/66452049f3d692768c39c797b21b793dce80314e/pkg/controller/volume/persistentvolume/pv_controller.go#L1321-L1389), and [backend removal can precede finalizer failure](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/66452049f3d692768c39c797b21b793dce80314e/pkg/controller/volume/persistentvolume/pv_controller.go#L1495-L1540).
>
> **Wait permissions and limit:** [Positive-timeout deletion waits get, then list/watch the named resource](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/66452049f3d692768c39c797b21b793dce80314e/staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/cmd/wait/delete.go#L45-L51), with [the selected list/watch calls](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/66452049f3d692768c39c797b21b793dce80314e/staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/cmd/wait/delete.go#L79-L89). [The delete command invokes that wait and can tolerate a denied or unsupported wait](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/66452049f3d692768c39c797b21b793dce80314e/staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/cmd/delete/delete.go#L460-L477). These pinned client expectations do not prove the operator's actual permissions.
>
> **Reason:** The [producer comment](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/51975b92ed5154b76c65793e55933b4d8659d05d/scripts/remove-qdrant.sh#L33-L34) says PVC deletion alone can leave retained PVs and data. Inference: setting `Delete` connects approved claim retirement to storage disposal. The historical reason for these specific incomplete concurrency guards is unknown. Platform operations owns reassessment when ownership, drivers, or retention requirements change.
>
> **Test evidence:** Local command syntax, synthetic exact selection, sanitized capture, read-only observation, discovery-denial and binding-refusal checks do not execute retirement against Kubernetes.
>
